programs.name: sumute
programs.purpose: Mute samples above, below, or around a curve defined by a trace header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMUTE - MUTE above (or below) a user-defined polygonal curve with

params.name: xmute
params.description: Curve positions; required unless hmute or both xfile and tfile are supplied.

params.name: tmute
params.description: Curve times or mute widths; required with xmute.

params.name: xfile
params.description: Binary float positions file, used together with tfile and nmute.

params.name: tfile
params.description: Binary float times file, used together with xfile and nmute.

params.name: nmute
params.description: Number of pairs in xfile and tfile; required when both files are supplied.

params.name: hmute
params.description: Header word containing mute time in milliseconds; replaces curve input.

params.name: key
params.description: Header word used for curve positions; ignored when hmute is supplied.

params.name: ntaper
params.description: Number of sine-squared taper samples.

params.name: mode
params.description: Mute above, below, around a straight line, hyperbola, or polygon for modes 0 through 4.

params.name: below
params.description: Obsolete alias that overrides mode after curve parameters are read.

params.name: absolute
params.description: Use absolute header value for line and hyperbola calculations.

params.name: linvel
params.description: Velocity for modes 2 and 3.

params.name: tm0
params.description: Time shift for modes 2 and 3.

params.name: twindow
params.description: Mute widths; required with vector input in mode 4.

params.name: twfile
params.description: Documented mode 4 widths file; the code never reads this parameter.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Interpolation, rounding, float/double mixing, sin and sqrt affect sample boundaries and taper values. Mode 4 interpolates using uninitialized twfval; its file path never reads twfile or allocates twindow. Some mute and taper bounds can access outside the trace, and hmute with mode 4 lacks window data.
programs.difficulty_reason: Several interpolation-based mute modes and edge cases share trace and header state.

test_cases.description: Mute above a curve with taper.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumute key=tracl xmute=1,8 tmute=0.02,0.08 ntaper=4
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumute key=tracl xmute=1,8 tmute=0.1,0.2 mode=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumute key=tracl xmute=1,8 tmute=0.02,0.04 mode=3 linvel=1000 tm0=0.05 ntaper=3

programs.name: sumutecsv
programs.purpose: Mute traces using offset-dependent curves interpolated between CDP locations.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMUTECSV - MUTE above (or below) bilinearly interpolated polygonal curves

params.name: qin
params.description: Q-file containing mute functions; otherwise cdp, offs and tims are required.

params.name: cdp
params.description: Mute function CDPs; required without qin.

params.name: offs
params.description: Offset values, supplied once or once per CDP; required without qin.

params.name: tims
params.description: Repeated time arrays, one per CDP; required without qin.

params.name: rfile
params.description: K-file with 3D grid definition.

params.name: grid_xa
params.description: Grid corner A x; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_ya
params.description: Grid corner A y; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_xb
params.description: Grid corner B x; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_yb
params.description: Grid corner B y; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_xc
params.description: Grid corner C x; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_yc
params.description: Grid corner C y; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_wb
params.description: Grid cell width along B; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: grid_wc
params.description: Grid cell width along C; required for a command-line grid unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: offkey
params.description: Offset header word.

params.name: abs
params.description: Use absolute offset when equal to 1.

params.name: ntaper
params.description: Number of sine-squared taper samples.

params.name: mode
params.description: Mute above, below, around a straight line, or around a hyperbola, for modes 0 through 3.

params.name: vel
params.description: Velocity for modes 2 and 3.

params.name: tzero
params.description: Time shift for modes 2 and 3, in the same units inferred for tims.

params.name: extrapi
params.description: Inline extrapolation option.

params.name: extrapc
params.description: Crossline extrapolation option.

params.name: extrapt
params.description: Offset extrapolation option; its range check mistakenly checks extrapc.

params.name: check
params.description: Print grid checks and mute locations.

params.name: print
params.description: Print input mute functions.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Bilinear and offset interpolation use doubles before conversion to float; lrint, NINT, sin and sqrt affect results. Time units switch when any input time exceeds 100. Mute and taper bounds can access outside the trace.
programs.difficulty_reason: Q-file and grid parsing, spatial interpolation, and multiple mute modes require substantial state handling.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumutecsv cdp=1 offs=0,1000 tims=0.02,0.08 ntaper=3

test_cases.description: Interpolate two CDP functions and mute below.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumutecsv cdp=1,10 offs=0,1000 tims=0.1,0.2 tims=0.15,0.25 mode=1 extrapi=1 extrapt=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sumutecsv cdp=1 offs=0,1000 tims=0.02,0.04 mode=2 vel=1000 tzero=0.05 abs=0

programs.license_note: Credits say it started as a copy of sunmocsv, itself derived from sunmo, with portions copied from sumute; credits include SEP, DELPHI and USBG contributors.

programs.name: supad
programs.purpose: Pad each input ensemble with zero traces at missing trace-key positions.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower trace-key boundary.

params.name: max
params.description: Upper trace-key boundary.

params.name: key1
params.description: Ensemble key.

params.name: key2
params.description: Trace position key.

params.name: key3
params.description: Padded-trace flag key.

params.name: val3
params.description: Flag value assigned to padded traces.

params.name: d
params.description: Trace-key spacing.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double spacing is repeatedly accumulated and converted to the chosen header type. Negative spacing uses the same dmin and dmax loop boundaries as positive spacing, despite the selfdoc's descending-order description.
programs.difficulty_reason: Padding depends on ensemble transitions, header types, and trace-key ordering.

test_cases.description: Append zero traces to a panel.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supad key1=offset key2=tracl min=1 max=10 d=1

test_cases.description: Insert intermediate traces and use a custom flag.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supad key1=offset key2=tracl key3=nhs val3=0 min=1 max=8 d=0.5

programs.name: supadmissing
programs.purpose: Insert zero traces for missing values of an increasing header key.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPADMISSING - Add Dead Traces For Missing Key Values.

params.name: keyloc
params.description: Increasing input header key.

params.name: incval
params.description: Positive key increment.

params.name: minval
params.default: computed: keyloc of first input trace
params.description: Minimum output key.

params.name: maxval
params.description: Maximum output key; when omitted, output stops at the last input trace.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double key positions are repeatedly incremented and compared exactly, then converted to the header type. End padding relies on the trace buffer retaining the last trace after a failed gettr.
programs.difficulty_reason: Trace filtering and padding depend on ordered keys and first- and last-trace state.

test_cases.description: Pad before and after input traces.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supadmissing keyloc=tracl incval=1 minval=0 maxval=10

test_cases.description: Insert fractional-key positions using an integer header.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | supadmissing keyloc=tracl incval=0.5 minval=1 maxval=8

programs.name: suputgthr
programs.purpose: Split successive input gathers into files named for a header key.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPUTGTHR - split the stdout flow to gathers on the bases of given

params.name: dir
params.description: Existing output directory.

params.name: key
params.description: Gather header key.

params.name: suffix
params.description: Output filename suffix.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print file information.

params.name: numlength
params.description: Minimum width of the numeric filename component.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Gather keys are converted to int for filenames, so distinct floating-point keys can collide. The boundary trace is counted in the preceding gather's ntr, while the new gather count starts at zero; empty input is not checked before its trace is used.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers in temporary files and manages boundary transitions and output filenames.

test_cases.description: Write one gather with a custom suffix.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | suputgthr dir=. key=ep suffix=.su numlength=3

test_cases.description: Split each trace into a separate gather.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | suputgthr dir=. key=tracl suffix=.su numlength=3 verbose=1

programs.license_note: Credits identify Balazs Nemeth of Potash Corporation, who gave the program to CWP in 2008.

programs.name: susort
programs.purpose: Sort traces by one or more header keys in ascending or descending order.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSORT - sort on any segy header keywords

params.name: [+-]key
params.description: Positional header keys, optionally prefixed with + or -, in priority order.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Equal keys compare equal and qsort does not guarantee stable ordering. Descending signed-key negation can overflow at the minimum value; unsigned reversal and floating NaNs have type-dependent behavior. Pipe input requires disk output and assumes a constant trace size.
programs.difficulty_reason: It sorts buffered header values and uses different random-access paths for disk and pipe input.

test_cases.description: Sort disk input by the default key.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 > in.su && susort < in.su > out.su

test_cases.description: Sort pipe input by descending trace number and a secondary key.
